ShortDescription.Value: In-game SVG drawing overlay for road, zone, and transit planning before you build.

Publish.LongDescription:
## Skyplan
Tracing paper over your city inside CS2.
Open the overlay with **Alt+P** (rebindable), sketch out your road network, zoning, and transit lines on top of the live map, then build with confidence.
Left-Click to start drawing, Right-Click to end the drawing.
For lines, left-click starts a new segment from the end of the previous one.
For polygons, left-click adds a point and right-click closes the shape.
For curves, left-click alternates between anchor and control points, and right-click ends the shape.
For Annotation, a small circle preview will be shown on the map where you clicked, a text field will show in the toolbar to write the text, then press **Enter** and the text will appear on the map.
For Points, a small circle with Icon in the middle with left-click on the map.
Right-click a selected tool or layer in the toolbar to deselect it.
### Disclaimer
This is a beta version, a lot of the feedback that i got on reddit is not yet implemented. even the Thumbnail is under development.
The features for the next version (v0.2.1) will be decided on GitHub. Follow the planned work in the milestone: https://github.com/aous-afk/skyplan/milestone/7
Suggest your own in the issues: https://github.com/aous-afk/skyplan/issues
### Experimental Features
* Planing Tools: * ServiceCatchmentSystem: when SkyPlan panel is open, if you clicked on a school or a hospital the UI will show you where its students/patients live.
### Features
* Line, polygon, curve, point and annotation drawing tools: plan roads, mark zones, drop points of interest * 38 built-in layers: Transit (Train, Subway, Tram, Bus), Roads (Highway to Local), Zones (Residential incl. Low/Medium/High/Mixed-Use, Commercial incl. High, Industrial, Office), Public Services, and Points of Interest (incl. custom icons), each with its own colour and style * Multi-layer parallel corridors: queue multiple layers in the toolbar (Shift+click) and draw once to get parallel lanes in that exact order, for both lines and curves. Adjust spacing live with Shift+scroll wheel * Snapping: lines and polygons snap to existing shapes, with an indicator shown on hover * World clicks (building select/placement) blocked while in Draw mode by default, toggleable in mod settings * Deselect active tool/layer with right-click * Fully customisable layers: edit `layers.json` to add, remove, or restyle any layer. Changes hot-swap without a game restart * Custom icons for point layers: define `icon: {path, color}` per layer in `layers.json`, renders in-game and in SVG export/import * World-space coordinates: shapes stay pinned to the map as you pan and zoom * Erase tool: with hover highlight * SVG export and import: save your plans as standard SVG files, open them in Inkscape, share them, or import them back later * Auto Save/Load: the game will auto save your shapes per city, and will load them on start * Undo/Redo: (Ctrl+Z)/(Ctrl+Y) * Draggable toolbar * Style Manager: edit any layer's colour, line width, dash pattern and label style with a live preview, then Save, or Save as a new layer * Shape Manager: view all shapes grouped by layer, edit the name and description of each shape, delete shapes, toggle layer visibility and label display * Canvas labels: shape names can be toggled to appear on the map at the shape's anchor point * Visual: global and per-layer opacity sliders * Per-layer visibility toggle
## Known Issues
* changing the styles in `layers.json` while already having shapes in the current session wont hot reload. it needs clear-all for the new style to take effect.
## Limitations
* Each line is a separate two-point segment, continuous polylines are planned but not yet implemented.
## Usage
Load a city, press **Alt+P**, draw.
## message from the developer
I have been working on this mod since 04.2026, and I still need time to call this mod a stable version. The development of this mod might be slow, for 2 reasons: - I am not a game-developer, I work as full-stack developer, my main languges are C#, TS and lua. C# and TS is perfect for cs2 mod but I am still figuring out unity and how it works. Lua I am working on neovim plugin (be free to check it out) - This mod is not AI-generated code, nor I plan to generate more code so I can push Features faster and release. I do enjoy coding and testing stuff out, and i will not let AI take away this enjoyment.
I plan to push experimental features to help planing, if you have suggestions, be free to write them or create github issue.
Publish.ChangeLog: ## 0.2.0-beta: Style Manager - Added: Style Manager, edit any layer's colour, line width, dash pattern and label style, with a live preview. Open it from the toolbar. - Added: Save / Save as in the Style Manager. Save writes your changes to the layer, Save as creates a new layer from them. Styles are stored in your layers.json and survive restarts. - Added: multi-line text, labels with line breaks now render on several lines. - UX: panel titles adjust to their length. - UI: - hover on the Shape Manager collapse toggle. - delete button on each shape row in the Shape Manager. - Bug fixes: - label styles from the layers file were ignored and overwritten. - SVG export used the wrong layer styles. - points and shapes no longer sink below the water surface. - SVGs made in other programs no longer import invisibly; they go into the "Imported" layer and keep their styles.
